steps.content: In the Void of Yin, blue-black mist coils around you as loose stones slip silently into the abyss below. The woman's fingertips brush your skin. You lock eyes with her, and find her pale cyan irises holding a deep, flickering crimson light.
In the next heartbeat, chaos floods your mind, a deafening roar of voices. Your body, no longer your own, is dragged inch by relentless inch toward the void.

steps.speaker: Pleading Voices
steps.content: Can you hear us...? You can hear us. I know you can...

steps.speaker: Pleading Voices
steps.content: If our sins are forgiven, will we finally be free?

steps.speaker: Pleading Voices
steps.content: Our families... our home... please, show us the way...
From every side, desperate prayers and sobbing cries swell in layered waves before crashing over you.

steps.speaker: Pleading Voices
steps.content: You can grant our prayers... we know you can...

steps.speaker: Pleading Voices
steps.content: Please, Master... Please, gods, watch over us... Please, we beg you...!
Within the churning currents, a more substantial figure materializes.
Without thinking, you extend your hand.
Yet your fingers slip straight through the shadow, closing around nothing more than a ghost of a breeze.
The figure turns to face you, features blurred and voice strange.

steps.speaker: Woman's Voice
steps.content: Just as I foresaw, the <color=#fb9259>baleful star</color> has fallen, erasing all in its wake and bringing ruin without end. You have witnessed it, all of it...

steps.speaker: Woman's Voice
steps.content: But do not lose your way... Come. Come to Maria City. Here, you shall find the path to <color=#fb9259>vanquishing evil</color>...

steps.speaker: Woman's Voice
steps.content: You will surely uncover it, and pass it down through the ages, shield those who are yet to come...
[Chengxiao's while silhouette]

steps.speaker: Young Man's Voice
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>Maria City</color>. It is true, that is where the <color=#fb9259>Perishing Star</color> first fell. Someone from □ Nation has already assembled an expedition to delve into its mysteries.

steps.speaker: Young Man's Voice
steps.content: But you and I both know full well that Shifu has long since passed. Returning from the dead and appearing in the living's dreams... reason dictates it simply cannot be so.

steps.speaker: Young Man's Voice
steps.content: I fear this so-called means to <color=#fb9259>vanquish evil</color>... may prove to be yet another trap laid by the <color=#fb9259>Perishing Star</color> itself.

steps.speaker: Young Man's Voice
steps.content: Even if I cast a divination, the signs will hardly be auspicious... Are you really resolved on this?
You try to form words, but instead, a familiar voice finds its way to your ears.
Dead or alive, true or false. You won't know until you go and see for yourself.
Divinations and hexagrams... they only fool those who wish to be fooled.
[Female Daoist's white silhouette]

steps.speaker: Woman's Voice
steps.content: ...Come... fulfill the wishes of the living...

steps.speaker: Woman's Voice?
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f>...reach the end you seek. And see what's been hidden all along...</color>
Summoning every last ounce of strength, you tear a desperate shout from your chest.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Who... are you?!
[Devotees' pale silhouettes]

steps.speaker: Chaotic Voices
steps.content: <i><color=#7683a2>...You came to save us, didn't you... You're the auspicious star... our auspicious star...</color><i>

steps.speaker: Chaotic Voices
steps.content: <i><color=#7683a2>...No... ruin... you will bring nothing but ruin...</color><i>

steps.speaker: Chaotic Voices
steps.content: <i><color=#7683a2>Are you a </color><color=#dg1f1f><size=48>baleful star</size></color><color=#7683a2> cast down from above, or our </color><color=#dg1f1f><size=48>auspicious star</size></color><color=#7683a2>?</color>
[Character portraits zoom in]

steps.speaker: Chaotic Voices
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f>Are you a <size=48>baleful star</size>, or an <size=48>auspicious star</size>? A <size=48>baleful</size> star or an <size=48>auspicious</size> star?</color>

steps.speaker: Chaotic Voices
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f><size=48>Baleful</size> star? Auspicious <size=48>star</size>? Baleful <size=48>star</size>? <size=48>Auspicious</size> star?</color>
[24 fast-forward to the ending CG of the previous chapter]

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: And you... could you be my auspicious star?
